description.en:
KnowCal turns every business card into a ready-to-use contact in seconds. Simply point your iPhone camera (or import a photo from your album) and the app instantly detects the card’s orientation, extracts the text with high-precision OCR, and parses the information into clean, editable fields.

Whether you’re networking at a conference, following up after a meeting, or simply digitizing a stack of cards, KnowCal makes the process fast, accurate, and completely secure. Download it now from the App Store and never lose a valuable contact again.
description.zh:
KnowCal 让每一张名片在几秒内变成可直接使用的联系人。用 iPhone 摄像头对准名片（或从相册导入照片），App 会自动识别名片方向，用高精度 OCR 提取文字，并把信息整理成干净、可编辑的字段。

无论是在会议现场交换名片、会后跟进，还是想把手头一叠名片数字化，KnowCal 都让整个过程快速、准确、完全安全。

en: Intelligent scanning & recognition – Automatic direction detection, perspective correction, and multi-language OCR handle both Chinese and English cards, even when the image is skewed or poorly lit.
Precise address extraction – Complex, multi-line addresses are intelligently identified and displayed in full, preserving street, district, postal code and other details without truncation.
True bilingual support – The interface and recognition results fluidly switch between Chinese and English, ensuring a seamless experience no matter the card’s language.
One-tap contact storage – Save the parsed data as a standard VCard with a single tap, directly add it to your Contacts, or update an existing entry.
QR-card import – Scan a vCard QR code to instantly create a contact without any manual input.
Privacy-first – All processing happens on-device; none of your card images or data ever leave your phone.
zh: 智能扫描识别 —— 自动方向检测、透视校正与多语言 OCR，中英文名片都能处理，即使图片倾斜或光线不佳。
精确地址识别 —— 智能解析复杂的多行地址并完整显示，街道、区、邮编等细节不会被截断。
真正的双语支持 —— 界面与识别结果在中英文间流畅切换，无论名片是哪种语言都能顺畅使用。
一键存入联系人 —— 识别结果一键保存为标准 VCard，直接加入通讯录，也可更新已有联系人。
二维码名片导入 —— 扫描 vCard 二维码即可立即创建联系人，无需手动输入。
隐私优先 —— 全部处理都在设备本地完成，名片图片与数据不会离开你的手机。

tagline.en: A full-screen clock with local weather, alarms and a world clock — a display meant to be seen from across the room
tagline.zh: 全屏时钟，含当地天气、闹钟与世界时钟——一块值得远远望过去的显示屏

description.en:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a display you actually want to look at. MyClock fills the screen with a beautifully drawn clock face, your local forecast and everything you need to start the day - with nothing else in the way.

MyClock is free to download and supported by ads. If you would rather not see them, a one-time in-app purchase removes every ad for good — it is not a subscription.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com.
description.zh:
把 iPhone 或 iPad 变成一块你真正愿意看的显示屏。MyClock 用精心绘制的表盘、当地天气和开启一天所需的信息填满整个屏幕，没有任何多余元素。

MyClock 免费下载，由广告支持；不想看广告可一次性内购永久移除，不是订阅制。

天气数据来自 Open-Meteo.com。

en: A clock worth looking at - Choose from eight original faces: Digital, Analog, Flip, LCD, Dot matrix, Rings, Word clock and Minimal. Every face is drawn from scratch for this app, sized to fill the screen edge to edge and readable from across the room. Tap once to bring up the tabs; tap the Clock tab and the display takes the whole screen back.

Weather where you are - See the current temperature, what it feels like, humidity and wind at a glance, followed by today and the next ten days. Tap any day for an hour-by-hour breakdown with the chance of rain and the sunrise and sunset times. Switch between Celsius and Fahrenheit in Settings.

Alarms on a 24-hour dial - The alarm tab shows a ring of all 24 hours, and the hours you have an alarm on are drawn thick. Tap an hour to add one. Each alarm can repeat on any combination of days, use one of ten tones, snooze for 5 to 30 minutes and carry its own label.

A world clock that keeps up - Swipe between cities to see the time anywhere, with the day shown relative to yours - yesterday, today or tomorrow. New York, Beijing, Geneva and London are there to start with, and you can add any of 267 cities across 116 countries.

Made to be left on - MyClock uses a dark interface that is easy on the eyes at night, hides the status bar when the display is full screen, and keeps the screen awake while the clock is showing. It runs on iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape.

Private by design - There is no account and no sign-in. Your alarms, cities and preferences stay on your device. Your location is used only to fetch the local forecast and is never stored on a server.
zh: 值得一看的时钟 —— 数字、指针、翻页、LCD、点阵、圆环、文字钟、极简八种原创表盘，全部从零绘制并铺满屏幕。
当地天气 —— 当前温度、体感、湿度与风力，加上今天和未来十天预报，可查看逐小时详情、降雨概率与日出日落。
24 小时表盘闹钟 —— 一圈 24 小时，点小时即可添加；可任选重复日、十种铃声、5–30 分钟贪睡与独立标签。
跟得上你的世界时钟 —— 城市间滑动查看，各地日期相对你所在地显示；覆盖 116 个国家、267 座城市。
适合长期显示 —— 深色界面、全屏显示、屏幕常亮；iPhone 与 iPad 横竖屏皆可。
隐私设计 —— 无需账号与登录，闹钟、城市和偏好只保存在你的设备上。

tagline.en: SEC filings viewer for US stocks
tagline.zh: 美股 SEC 文件浏览器

description.en:
Filingo is an iOS app focused on US stocks: manage your watchlist, view company details and read SEC filings — all from a single source, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

Search and build a watchlist where each row shows the company name, exchange and its most recent filing type. Open a company for an overview, fundamental trends (revenue, net income and EPS from SEC XBRL data) and its latest filings.

Filings are browsed in three levels — company, then form type with counts, then the specific filing — and read in an embedded viewer that loads the original document straight from sec.gov.

Filingo displays only data publicly released by the SEC and shows no market data.
description.zh:
Filingo 是一款专注美股的 iOS App：管理自选股、查看公司详情、阅读 SEC 文件——数据全部来自同一个来源，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）。

你可以搜索并建立自选股列表，每一行显示公司名称、交易所和最近一次申报的文件类型；进入公司可查看概览、基本面趋势（来自 SEC XBRL 数据的营收、净利润与每股收益）以及最近的申报文件。

文件按三级浏览——公司 → 文件类型（带数量）→ 具体文件——并在内置阅读器中直接加载 sec.gov 上的原始文档。

Filingo 仅展示 SEC 公开发布的数据，不提供任何行情信息。

en: Watchlist management - Search and manage your US stock watchlist, with company name, exchange and latest filing type per row.
Company details - Overview plus fundamental trends (revenue, net income, EPS) from SEC XBRL data, and the latest five filings.
Three-level filings browser - Company, then form type with counts, then the specific filing.
Filing reader - An embedded viewer loads the raw documents directly from sec.gov.
One data source - Everything comes from SEC EDGAR; no market data is shown.
zh: 自选股管理 —— 搜索并管理美股自选列表，每行显示公司名称、交易所与最近申报类型。
公司详情 —— 概览，加上来自 SEC XBRL 数据的营收、净利润、每股收益趋势，以及最近 5 份文件。
三级文件浏览 —— 公司 → 文件类型（带数量）→ 具体文件。
文件阅读器 —— 内置阅读器直接加载 sec.gov 上的原始文档。
单一数据源 —— 全部来自 SEC EDGAR，不展示行情数据。
